subject: MAP: NeuroLytics capacity sync — regional GPU commitments & owners
messages:
From: Jane Simmons <jane.simmons@neurolytics.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@neurolytics.ai <procurement@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — capacity sizing and timelines

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. NeuroLytics is ready to lock down our MAP (mutual action plan) for the next 12 months — we need committed capacity numbers and a close timeline so our procurement and cloud teams can align. High-level asks from our side:

- Dedicated/private deployment preference for PHI workloads (VPC + KMS)
- Regions: primary in us-west-2, DR in eu-west-1, evaluation in ap-southeast-1 (pilot)
- Target peak concurrency: ~140 concurrent inference streams for chat + 300 rps for embeddings workflows (70% read-heavy)
- SLOs: 95th pct latency <200ms for chat (short prompts)

Can your team propose a preliminary GPU mix (type + count) and a week-by-week timeline for evaluation -> pilot -> reserved commit? Attaching our draft requirements (see NeuroLytics_requirements_v1.pdf).

Would like to schedule a MAP checkpoint next week — Wed or Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Jane Simmons
Head of ML Ops, NeuroLytics
Jane.Simmons@neurolytics.ai

On Fri, 14 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700, Alex Moroz <alex@neurolytics.ai> wrote:
> Kicking this off on our side too — procurement looped above.
> 
> Alex

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Simmons <jane.simmons@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, procurement@neurolytics.ai <procurement@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — capacity sizing and timelines

Jane — thanks for the clear requirements. I put together a short agenda and a preliminary sizing proposal for Wednesday's checkpoint. Attaching: NeuroLytics_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet with options) and a short network diagram request (neurolytics_network_diagram.pdf) that we need filled in by your infra team.

Proposed quick agenda (30 min):
- 5m: goals & timeline agreement (evaluation -> pilot -> commit)
- 10m: sizing options by region (GPU type and count)
- 10m: throughput & latency targets validation (we'll map to SLOs)
- 5m: owners & next steps (action item capture)

Preliminary sizing (option A — conservative, Option B — performance):
- us-west-2 (primary / dedicated): Option A: 6 x A100-40GB (dedicated pool) | Option B: 4 x H100-80GB + 4 x A100-40GB
- eu-west-1 (DR / small dedicated): 2 x A100-40GB (standby pool)
- ap-southeast-1 (pilot / shared): 2 x A10G or equivalent for lower-cost eval

Throughput targets mapped to these mixes:
- Chat concurrency target (140 streams): Option A ~110–140 concurrent with graceful queuing; Option B ~140–180 with room for burst.
- Embeddings (300 rps): Option A handles ~240–320 depending on batch sizing; Option B is optimized for >=320 with quantized model variants.

Can Wed 19 May 2027 1:00pm PT or Thu 20 May 11:00am PT work? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite and update the MAP spreadsheet after the call.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: NeuroLytics_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: neurolytics_network_diagram.pdf (request)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — capacity sizing and timelines

I'll join Wednesday at 1pm PT. A couple of quick ops notes to bring to the call so we have clear owners: 

- Networking: we need NeuroLytics' VPC peering and egress policies (Laura to follow up with the infra contact).
- Security: confirm encryption-at-rest for dedicated pools, KMS key rotation window. Vivek, can you confirm whether we should propose Redwood-managed or customer-managed KMS for their compliance?
- Billing/commit structure: propose a 12-month reserved tier with a 3-month evaluation credit runway. I'll draft the contract skeleton post-call.

Action owners I propose to capture during the call:
- Karthik: update MAP spreadsheet with chosen option and region-specific counts
- Monica: draft preliminary procurement terms and evaluation credits
- Vivek: confirm KMS recommendation & escalate any security blockers
- Laura: collect network diagram details from NeuroLytics infra contact (Alex)

Monica Patel
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Simmons <jane.simmons@neurolytics.ai>, Alex Moroz <alex@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@neurolytics.ai <procurement@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint recap & agreed commitments — NeuroLytics

Team — thanks for the productive checkpoint. Below is the runbook-style recap (owners, deliverables, dates). Please treat this as the official MAP update; I'll upload the minutes to the MAP folder and share a HubSpot update after this note.

Summary of commitments (agreed during 22 May call):
- Final decision: NeuroLytics chose Option B (performance-focused) for production dedicated pools in us-west-2. Pilot will run quantized variants to validate cost/latency tradeoffs.

Capacity by region (committed during MAP):
- us-west-2 (production dedicated): 4 x H100-80GB (primary inference) + 4 x A100-40GB (aux/overflow) — target online by 2027-06-15
- eu-west-1 (DR, warm standby): 2 x A100-40GB — target online by 2027-06-30
- ap-southeast-1 (pilot / shared): 2 x A10G-equivalent (short-term) — pilot window 2027-06-01 -> 2027-07-15

Throughput & SLO mapping (targets):
- Chat: 140 concurrent streams with 95th pct latency <200ms (short prompts) — validated by 2027-06-20 performance test
- Embeddings: steady-state 300 rps (batching to be tuned) — baseline test scheduled 2027-06-10

Owners & action items (summary):
- Karthik Iyer (owner): Update MAP spreadsheet with final counts and submit committed SKU list to provisioning — due 2027-05-24 (Attachment: NeuroLytics_MAP_v3.xlsx updated).
- Monica Patel (owner): Draft procurement term sheet (12-month reserved, 3-month eval credit), circulate for legal review — due 2027-05-27.
- Vivek Kulkarni (owner): KMS recommendation (Redwood-managed vs customer-managed) and security checklist — due 2027-05-25.
- Laura Bennett (owner): Collect VPC peering details and confirm allowed egress IPs — due 2027-05-23 (Alex to provide network diagram).
- NeuroLytics (Alex & Jane): Provide detailed network diagram and confirm data retention policy for PHI — due 2027-05-21 (neurolytics_network_diagram.pdf referenced).

Test & evaluation schedule (milestones):
- 2027-06-01: Pilot environment available in ap-southeast-1 (shared)
- 2027-06-10: Baseline throughput tests for embeddings (Monica + NeuroLytics)
- 2027-06-15: Production pool provisioning complete in us-west-2 (Redwood infra ops)
- 2027-06-20: Performance validation run for chat latency; go/no-go for commit

Risks & mitigations quickly noted:
- Risk: KMS/customer-managed encryption may add delay to provisioning. Mitigation: Vivek to provide recommendation and quick-start template for customer-managed KMS.
- Risk: Network whitelisting delays. Mitigation: Laura to escalate if NeuroLytics does not supply diagram by due date.

Next checkpoint: Weekly MAP sync Friday 2027-05-28 10:00am PT (15 min) — cadence until commit closed. I'll send a recurring invite for Fridays.

Attachments uploaded: NeuroLytics_MAP_v3.xlsx (updated), MAP-meeting-minutes-20270522.docx

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
